subject: math.CV
name: Two-dimensional Jacobian conjecture
statement: If F:ℂ²→ℂ² is a polynomial map whose Jacobian determinant is a nonzero constant, must F have a polynomial inverse?
importance: It is a fundamental proposed bridge between local holomorphic invertibility and global algebraic invertibility.
status_note: The entry restricts to dimension two; results and recent claims in other dimensions do not resolve this case.

subject: math.CV
name: Brennan’s conjecture
statement: For every simply connected proper plane domain Ω and conformal bijection φ:Ω→D, is ∫_Ω |φ′(z)|^p dA(z) finite for every 4/3<p<4?
importance: It predicts sharp integrability of conformal-map derivatives and links complex analysis with Sobolev theory.
status_note: The endpoint exponents are excluded, and only portions of the full exponent interval and special domain classes are known.

references.title: Gol’dshtein and Ukhlov, Sobolev homeomorphisms and Brennan’s conjecture

subject: math.CV
name: Greene–Krantz conjecture
statement: For a bounded domain Ω⊂ℂⁿ with C∞ boundary, must every boundary orbit accumulation point of its holomorphic automorphism group be of finite D’Angelo type?
importance: It is central to classifying domains with large automorphism groups through boundary geometry.
status_note: There are proofs for important special classes, including convex situations; the general smooth-domain statement is unresolved.

references.title: The Greene–Krantz Conjecture in Dimension Two

subject: math.CV
name: Ramadanov conjecture in higher dimension
statement: For a bounded strictly pseudoconvex C∞ domain Ω⊂ℂⁿ with n≥3, if the logarithmic coefficient in the Fefferman expansion of its Bergman kernel vanishes to infinite order at the boundary, must that boundary be locally CR equivalent to the sphere?
importance: It asks whether an analytic feature of the Bergman kernel determines spherical boundary geometry.
status_note: The dimension-two case is known; this entry concerns the unresolved higher-dimensional implication, not the resolved Cheng conjecture.

references.title: Engliš and Zhang, Ramadanov conjecture and line bundles over compact Hermitian symmetric spaces

subject: math.CV
name: Proper embeddings of open Riemann surfaces into ℂ²
statement: Does every connected open Riemann surface admit a proper holomorphic embedding into ℂ²?
importance: It is the sharp embedding-dimension problem for one-dimensional Stein manifolds.
status_note: Proper embeddings into ℂ³ and many ℂ² special cases are known; the universal ℂ² assertion remains open.

references.title: Forstnerič and Wold, Bordered Riemann surfaces in ℂ²

subject: math.CV
name: Exact Bloch constant
statement: Determine the largest universal B such that every holomorphic f on D with f′(0)=1 has a subdomain on which f is injective and whose image is a Euclidean disk of radius B.
importance: This is a basic sharp constant governing the size of schlicht disks inside holomorphic images.
status_note: Positive lower and upper bounds are known; the conjectured extremal value has not been proved.

subject: math.CV
name: Exact Landau constant
statement: Determine the largest universal L such that, for every holomorphic f on D with f′(0)=1, the image f(D) contains a Euclidean disk of radius L.
importance: It is a classical extremal problem on how much geometric size is forced by one derivative value.
status_note: Unlike the Bloch constant, the preimage need not be a domain of injectivity. The exact optimal constant remains unknown.

references.title: Bloch’s theorem — discussion of Bloch and Landau constants

subject: math.CV
name: Four exponentials conjecture
statement: If x₁,x₂ are complex numbers linearly independent over ℚ and y₁,y₂ are complex numbers linearly independent over ℚ, must at least one of exp(xᵢyⱼ), 1≤i,j≤2, be transcendental?
importance: It is a central proposed restriction on algebraic relations among complex exponential values.
status_note: The six exponentials theorem proves the analogous assertion for a 2-by-3 array; the 2-by-2 case remains open.

subject: math.CV
name: Universal integral-means spectrum
statement: Determine, for every real p, the exact supremum over bounded univalent functions f on D of limsup_{r→1⁻} log(∫₀^{2π}|f′(re^{it})|^p dt)/log(1/(1−r)).
importance: The spectrum measures the most extreme boundary distortion allowed by conformal maps and includes major derivative-integrability questions.
status_note: Sharp values in some exponent ranges and many bounds are known; the full spectrum for bounded univalent maps is not determined.

references.title: Complex exponential integral means spectra of univalent functions and the Brennan conjecture

subject: math.CV
name: Schanuel’s conjecture
statement: If z₁,…,z_n∈ℂ are linearly independent over ℚ, is the transcendence degree over ℚ of ℚ(z₁,…,z_n,e^{z₁},…,e^{z_n}) at least n?
importance: It would organize a vast range of open questions about algebraic relations among complex exponentials.
status_note: Several classical transcendence theorems cover special settings, but the general assertion remains unproved.
